message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout right when I was about to watch my favorite show. I scrambled around to find a flashlight and realized my phone was nearly dead too—talk about bad timing! I quickly grabbed my power bank and settled in with a lantern instead. It turned into a cozy evening of storytelling that I hadn’t planned at all. Have you ever had a tech mishap during an outage that turned into a fun surprise?
